up: For compounds tested in assay CHEMBL1613995, retrieve the exact activity values. The output must include the following columns for each qualifying activity: compound CHEMBL ID (molecule_chembl_id), standard relation (standard_relation), standard value (standard_value), and standard units (standard_units). Return all matching activity rows without limiting the number of results.
sql:
SELECT
  a.molregno,
  a.standard_relation,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
WHERE
  ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1613995'
  AND a.standard_relation = '=';

up: Show the exact activity values for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL1613995. Return the compound CHEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), standard relation, standard value, and standard units for each activity.
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
  a.standard_relation,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
WHERE
  ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1613995'
  AND a.standard_relation = '=';
